posts.text: I'm proud that the people of Central Florida continue to put their trust in me, and I don't take that for granted. Over the last term, we've fought for the rights and dignity of all people. Pushing to build power with and for the working class.

posts.text:
I will run my biggest campaign operation since my first election.
Although I won't be on the ballot, we're focused on electing good people. We've already brought on 87 campaign Organizers this summer to help us flip seats across Central Florida and elect progressive champions.
